text:
maya: Quick sync — we're getting 3 customer asks this week asking for faster visibility into cost & errors. proposing a small 'cost hotspot' widget + lightweight tracing hooks for heavy routes. thoughts?
liam: +1 to the hotspot widget. do we mean per-model / per-route cost breakdown in the console?
anika: yes per-route, plus a quick link to example traces. customers want to find expensive paths without drilling into full traces.
maya: exactly. MVP idea: top 5 routes by spend (24h) with avg latency, p50/p95, and an 'inspect' button that pulls a sampled trace. lightweight.
raj: sampling is where this gets tricky. if we sample 0.1% on high-traffic routes we still might miss important errors. suggest error-priority sampling: always capture first error occurrence per minute + head-sample for latency spikes.
sam_ops: +1 on error-priority. also we should cap retention — storing full traces is expensive. propose 7-day full traces for hotspot hits, aggregated metrics for 30 days.
maya: good constraints. customer asks: 
- FinPay: wants 1-click to see cost delta after deploy, and ability to annotate a trace to link to rollout ID.
- HealthKit: needs PCI-friendly mode — no request bodies in traces and host redaction.
- EduLabs: wants an alert when a route's cost-per-request increases >20% week-over-week.
liam: callouts for product: must support per-tenant RBAC for the widget and a toggle for private deployments.
anika: acceptance criteria proposal (short):
```
- Hotspot widget shows top-5 routes by token-cost over 24h
- Each route row: route name, req/s, avg latency, p95 latency, cost per 1k requests, "Inspect" link
- "Inspect" opens a sampled trace (no bodies in PCI mode)
- Traces captured via sampling policy: head-sample + first-error-per-minute
- Retention: full traces 7d, aggregates 30d
- RBAC: view/edit toggles for per-tenant roles
- Canary requirement: feature rolled out to 10% of orgs behind a flag
```
raj: technical notes: implementing head-sample + first-error-per-minute needs a small stateful counter per route per minute — could be sharded by route hash and stored in redis with 65s TTL. impact estimate: negligible if we shard correctly.
sam_ops: infra ask: need an index in trace store for route and deploy-id to support finpay annotation search. small schema change.
maya: launch gating suggestions:
- Functional: widget renders with real data for >=3 internal workloads
- Security: PCI mode validated by security team, KMS integration tested for private deployments
- Perf: sampling adds <0.5ms p99 to request path (benchmark target)
- Observability: dashboard with sampling rate, captured-errors-per-hour, and storage spend delta
liam: prioritization: do we treat this as a 2-sprint scoped "mini-ship" or spread across roadmap quarter?
manika: (typo) i mean anika: i think mini-ship if we cut some niceties (no per-tenant custom sampling rules initially). basic RBAC + PCI toggle + canary is reasonable.
raj: agree — core work: sampling infra + trace index + UI rows. extras (annotations UI, per-tenant sampling control) can be v2.
maya: ok decision: MVP for Q1 mini-ship. owners: maya (PM), liam (design/metrics), raj (sampling infra), sam_ops (store/retention), anika (frontend).
maya: next steps: liam to prototype widget mockups by EOD Wed, raj to spike redis counter approach and cost estimate, sam_ops to draft trace-store schema PR, anika to stub UI and wire feature flag. i'll sync with security on PCI checklist.
deploy-bot: deploy job queued: feature-flag scaffolding branch created -> ci/ff-hook (build queued) :rocket:
liam: i'll add a tiny user story for FinPay deploy-annotation in the ticket backlog, tag QA.
anika: noted — will include canary flag and telemetry hooks (sampling-rate metric) in frontend.
maya: thanks all — i'll follow up with a short spec doc and prioritization note for roadmap sync. :thumbsup:
